set.body: Replace the development-only v1/v2/v3 Transport surfaces with one unversioned public gaze_transport API backed by the frozen v3 estimator. Remove the original and v2 implementations, tests, documentation, exports, and S3 classes while retaining immutable validation reports as historical evidence. Acceptance: only unversioned Transport names are public; gaze_weave_cv dispatches engine='transport' or Replay; canonical tests/docs pass; frozen v3 numerical fixtures remain unchanged.
set.title: GW-18.12 Canonicalize Transport API and remove development versions
